text:
maya: Ok team — quick sync on the tutorials + refapp push for next month. Goal: a lightweight translated path (ES + JA) + a 30-min webinar to drive dev signups.
jamie: Love it. timeline? i can run promo emails and the socials.
maya: Target publish date for the refapp guides is 2 weeks from today. webinar one week after that.
jamie: Can we fold in a benchmark narrative for the blog post — small infographic + TL;DR about latency/cost improvements for common prompts?
oliver: Yep. I can run a 3-workload microbenchmark (chat, embedding, rerank) on the refapp flows. Will aim for numbers and a little explainer about batching + kv-cache effects.
sophia: For translation: want community contributors to help. I'll draft a contributor guide and a short spreadsheet for strings. Also propose we ship English + Spanish first, then JP as follow-up.
maya: Nice. What do we want in the webinar? demo, benchmark highlights, quick start, Q&A. 30 mins-ish. Host: jamie + oliver?
jamie: I'm fine hosting. oliver can do the demo and benchmark walkthrough. sophia can cover localization/community bits.
oliver: Will prepare a 7-slide benchmark narrative: methodology, workloads, results, cost delta, ops tips. Also include a reproducible command snippet:```
# reproduce microbench
python run_bench.py --model redwood-base-quant --batch 8 --seq 512 --workload chat,embed
```
maya: Good. Messaging iteration: i want 3 variants for the launch post: (A) technical audience, (B) product-focused, (C) community/contributor angle. jamie you own final copy.
jamie: Will draft 3 variants by Thursday EOD. we'll A/B test subject lines in emails.
sophia: Inbound lead routing: can we route signups to a special list for the refapp webinar? pipeline-bot can create a list and tag leads with "refapp-webinar-2024"
pipeline-bot: Created list "refapp-webinar-2024" and webhook https://hooks.redwood.ai/inbound/refapp-webinar-2024
maya: Perfect. Also add a lightweight pre-webinar survey to filter enterprise vs hobbyists. keep one required question: "Primary use case".
jamie: I'll include survey in the registration form and add a hidden utm param for traffic source.
oliver: For the blog benchmark we should include a small reproducible notebook link and call out cost numbers with a short methodology note to avoid confusion. I'll push the notebook to the refapp repo under /benchmarks/webinar.
sophia: For translations: timeline for community review — 3 days per language. I'll post prompts + strings in the repo and ask translators to open PRs.
maya: Assignments recap: jamie — copy + email + social; oliver — benchmarks + demo; sophia — translations + contributor guide; maya — editorial calendar + webinar logistics. Deadline: publish assets (guides + blog) by 1718700000 (approx 2 weeks).
jamie: Quick checklist for social: 1) short teaser, 2) benchmark highlight card, 3) registration CTA, 4) colab/invite to contribute translations. I'll mock 3 variants.

sophia: Suggestion: run a small pre-release with a handful of community contributors to surface translation/clarity issues. We can do a 48-hour soft-launch.
maya: 👍 do it. oliver can seed the benchmark data.
oliver: Will share results and a small explainer doc for reproducibility.
pipeline-bot: New lead created: user="alice.dev" tags=["refapp-webinar-2024","email-signup"]
jamie: ":thumbsup: nice. also thinking about an evergreen short guide (1-pager) that we can link from the webinar follow-up email.
maya: Add a follow-up sequence: day 1 send recording + 1-pager + repo link, day 7 send how-to for integrating the refapp into a small project, day 21 check-in with a survey. jamie own sequence.
sophia: I'll prepare translation links and a short blurb contributors can use in their bios.
maya: Final Q: any concerns about benchmarks being misinterpreted? we should add an explicit "testbed & constraints" section in the blog.
oliver: Agreed. I'll include testbed, datasets, and exact commands. Also a note: "results will vary by workload and infra".
jamie: I'll keep headlines conservative: "example throughput & cost for common dev flows" instead of absolute claims.
maya: Great. next sync Thursday 11am. I'll create a brief Asana task list and ping owners.
sophia: ping me when the repo strings are up. I'll recruit translators from the community channel.
pipeline-bot: Reminder: Webinar scheduled in Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/webinar-refapp-2024 on 1718780000
maya: Closing — thanks team, solid plan.
